overall_limitations: This is an independent version-blinded model judgment of the supplied finished-product evidence. I inspected only the common packet and my own review order/directory; no source code, execution logs, assignment/version mapping, other reviewers' judgments, or personal context informed the review.

I followed the assigned pair order: S06/S01, S05/S03, S10/S09, S02/S07, S08/S04, and S11/S12. Each output was first oriented through its stable overview, then inspected through originals, and returned to whole-product context before its comparison was finalized.

Actual unique visual coverage is 192 required original stable screenshots, 36 supplemental original screenshots, 24 output overview images, 61 selected original temporal samples, and three benchmark original images: 316 images in total. Eight common packet documents were also read. The viewed_files array contains the exact unique packet-relative files inspected; the separate REVIEW-ORDER.json was read from my assigned reviewer directory.

All required 1440-, 900-, and 390-pixel stable conditions were inspected. T1 and T2 include both supplied themes; T2 includes overview, projects, schedule, and detail in every supplied width/theme combination. T3 includes notebook, compact, expanded, and second source at every supplied width; no alternate T3 theme was supplied.

Temporal overviews were used to orient to the full ordered sequences, with the listed original samples opened for consequential state and geometry judgments. I did not open every temporal image individually and did not watch the browser video or any continuous natural-motion playback. Natural motion quality, easing, frame rate, latency, physical gesture feel, and user effects are unassessed.

The states scores address visible pending/error/saved communication, selection and editing affordances, and sampled continuity only. A saved label, retained draft, or settled screenshot does not verify persistence, interruption correctness, retry/Stop behavior, keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, actual drag thresholds, or source-change races.

Screenshots show selected viewport positions. Partly visible source rails, clipped excerpts, below-fold editors, and text near fixed docks were described as observed layout conditions, not proof that content or controls are unreachable. Full long-source reading and scrolling behavior were not operated.

T1 attachment/removal workflows, new-thread/continuing-thread behavior, history persistence, and full keyboard access are not established by the viewed images. T2 filtering, arbitrary record editing, save outcomes, empty/error conditions, and complete register behavior are likewise unverified. T3 full-text navigation, per-source draft retention, note persistence, and focus/gesture mechanics remain unverified.

Typography and surface judgments were made from original raster images where detail mattered. There was no contrast-ratio measurement, browser zoom or text-scaling test, physical-device inspection, assistive-technology test, or extended reading/user study.

The Vane benchmark is the supplied static author-image set only. Comparisons concern populated visual hierarchy and product maturity while allowing an independent Folio identity; they do not establish parity with any commercial backend or broader service.

The six dimension ratings are separate ordinal judgments. No sum, weighted aesthetic total, percentage interpretation, or implied human-user preference was used. Empty material_defects arrays mean that no persistent material defect was established from these captures; minor weaknesses and uncertain transient crops remain explicitly documented in dimension evidence and limitations.
